decisions.reason: Clean data definition and biometric data risks are distinct topics sharing only a broad data context; no direct framework or review relationship exists.
CH01 defines the concept of predicate crimes; CH02 directly applies and specializes this definition to tax evasion as a specific predicate offense.
Internal audit function and HR training are distinct compliance functions; they share a broad compliance domain but lack a direct structural dependency.
6AMLD provisions and FATF mutual evaluations are distinct regulatory topics; they share the AML domain but do not form a direct framework-to-application relationship.
PEP screening outsourcing and AFC technology risk assessment are distinct operational controls; they share a broad risk context but no direct structural link.
G-20 ACWG Action Plan and residual risks action plan are different types of action plans sharing only the term 'action plan' without a direct review dependency.
National identity databases and customer outreach are distinct KYC methods; they share the broad KYC context but do not form a direct framework-to-application relationship.
CH59 defines the role-based access control and need-to-know principles; CH58 directly applies these principles to specify data requirements for compliance controls.
CIP for legal persons and digital identity verification advantages are distinct identity topics; they share the broad identity verification domain but lack a direct structural dependency.
CH42 defines the CDD requirements and mandatory ongoing monitoring; CH36 directly applies this framework to categorize customers and determine risk-based treatment levels.
